propositions: Header values configured at the surface and resolved from per-run identity are not currently delivered to wire requests via extra_headers, preventing gateway attribution and grouping of gate calls
Header values must be resolved with ${run:...} interpolation and passed through pydantic-ai's ModelSettings.extra_headers at the build_model_settings call site to reach all providers
Header values must never be redacted from durable records like provider_provenance and verdict findings, only header names recorded
A copy of the resolved headers dict must be passed per call to prevent mutation of the config-held mapping and pollution across calls
Headers carrying ${run:...} references should be omitted entirely outside gate-run scopes rather than sent empty, while literal headers remain present
Validation must be re-applied after ${run:...} substitution to reject values that become unsafe after interpolation
